# Extract balance data from the table - the last columns are Total investments + Unexpended balance
# Balance = Total investments + Unexpended balance

    1936: 18.9 + 0,  # * means less than $50,000, treat as 0
    1937: 312.4 + 0.1,
    1938: 884.2 + 12.2,
    1939: 1280.5 + 13.5,
    1940: 1724.9 + 13.4,
    1941: 2283.7 + 8.0,
    1942: 3150.1 + 7.8,
}

print("Unemployment Trust Fund Total Balances (millions):")
for year, balance in balances.items():
    print(f"  FY {year}: {balance}")

# Calculate 4-year moving averages
moving_averages = []
for start_year in range(1936, 1939):  # 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939 (ending 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942)
    years = [start_year, start_year+1, start_year+2, start_year+3]
    avg = sum(balances[y] for y in years) / 4
    moving_averages.append((years, avg))
    print(f"  4-year MA ({years[0]}-{years[-1]}): {avg}")

# Find the range
min_ma = min(ma[1] for ma in moving_averages)
max_ma = max(ma[1] for ma in moving_averages)

print(f"\nRange of 4-year moving averages: {min_ma:.1f} to {max_ma:.1f}")
print(f"Range: {max_ma - min_ma:.1f}")
EOF
